findings.title: Commented inventory can become a successful empty list
findings.change: parse_lifeplanet reads `var result = …` only from the executable text of real, non-inert JavaScript script elements collected by the HTML tokenizer; a minimal JS lexer skips comments and string/template literals and requires a statement-boundary `var`. HTML comments, templates, data-typed scripts, JS comments, string literals and text nodes are ParseFailed (never empty_success); two executable statements are ambiguous.

findings.title: Valid login HTML can be counted as successful enumeration
findings.change: looks_like_login first runs the HTML tokenizer and compares entity-decoded, trimmed, case-folded attribute values of real tags (input type/name/id/autocomplete, form action/onsubmit; inert contexts included; `auth` added to action markers). The legacy raw-text scan is kept as a second, conservative pass.

findings.title: The documented merge gate still fails (check_deps)
findings.change: Unchanged. dependency-boundary.json now records that the same three ontology findings reproduce on a clean export of origin/main, that this branch introduces zero findings and none inside allowed paths, and that the checker is in neither .github/workflows nor the supervisor test command. No waiver or suppression. The PR body no longer labels it as this PR's merge blocker but as a repository open item needing an authorized task on packages/ontology or infra/ci/deps.json.

findings.title: Advertised zero bypasses empty-list reconciliation
findings.change: AdvertisedTotalReached now requires total > 0, unique >= total and no endpoint-reported next cursor (Cursor pagination). Zero items with total zero goes through the empty-page reconciliation: first page without next → EmptyPage/empty_success/EnumeratedEmpty; with next cursor → keep walking. Items under an advertised zero or a cursor past the total are contradictions the walk follows to the list's own end.
